kitDescription: Dolla is a Wind Supporter sniper whose value is squad support rather than personal damage. On a repeating timer she grants the whole team a 16.16% ATK buff that lasts 5 seconds. Every time the team enters Full Burst she shortens all allies' Burst Skill cooldowns, starting at 1.82 seconds and adding 2.2 then 2.6 seconds on the next two entries, settling at 6.62 seconds off per Full Burst from the third entry onward. Each time she personally fires her Burst Skill she stacks escalating team buffs — ATK up on her first cast, adding Critical Rate on her second, and Critical Damage from her third on — each lasting 5 seconds. Her Burst Skill itself is a single shot at the enemy with the highest DEF for 734.69% of her final ATK.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: all four load-bearing kit lines are FAITHFUL (right primitive, trigger, scope, duration, cumulative-escalation semantics) and the one inert clause (burst DEF-ranking target selection) is a DOCUMENTED_GAP recorded by driver and both blind agents. The blind re-derivations converged hard: S6's skill2 and burst blocks are byte-identical to the driver's, and the sole divergence — S1 interval 20 vs the driver's 10 — is a blind-side recon error (the blind writer lacked skillCooldownsSec and flagged its 20 as INVENTED; the datamined skillCooldownsSec.skill1=10 in the ground truth confirms the driver). The S5 as-written reds (12) were all harness-API/fixture artifacts of the blind writer (onEvent placement, null-vs-undefined, a crown fixture that silenced dolla's casts, and the count-ceiling CDR instrument), not override divergences; the adapted run preserving every kit claim and counterfactual went 24/24 GREEN, and the driver's own test independently discriminates against the passive-S1, flat-CDR, non-cumulative, saturated, and flat-stat-ladder wrong models. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing assertion. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: all agents share the repo convention that a clause-less skill is an interval timer (owner-stated mechanic, snow-white precedent) with the ⚑ t=N first-fire phase, and share the unverified assumption that the 4th+ escalation activation re-applies all three steps — one focused popup-cadence read of S1's first buff window and one late-fight escalation check would retire both; neither blocks GO.
